pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: The Swing
work.note: "The Swing" é um poema infantil do escocês Robert Louis Stevenson, publicado em 1885 no livro "A Child's Garden of Verses". Em versos curtos e rimados, uma criança descreve o prazer de subir e descer num balanço, de ver o campo, o rio e os telhados de cima e de voltar ao ponto de partida. pages.title: My free time in Boston · 1/3
paragraphs: My name is Jack, and I live in **Boston**. In my free time I play soccer and read books. I **enjoy reading** on the train, and I **enjoy swimming** in the summer.

Last week my friend Grace asked, “What do you do in your free time?” “I play soccer,” I said. “And you?” “I play guitar,” she said. “I’m **into music**.” I asked, “Do you play in a band?” “No, I play at home. Just for fun.”
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: My free time in Boston · 2/3
paragraphs: “Do you want to play soccer on Saturday?” I asked. “Sure! What time?” “At ten, in the park.” “I’m in! **Don’t be late**,” she said, and we both laughed.

My favorite poem is “The Swing,” by Robert Louis Stevenson. He wrote it in 1885. In the poem, a child goes up and down on a swing and sees the garden and the river. The child is **having a blast**. I think hobbies are like a swing: they make you happy.

pages.title: My free time in Boston · 3/3
paragraphs: On Saturday we played soccer, and then we had lunch. It was a very good morning. What do you do for fun?
